{{Quote|I must say, I hadn't realized my reputation was growing quite so fast.|Arabelle Lorteli|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Arabelle Lorteli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zoolli]] [[Judge/Legends|judge]] handpicked in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to oversee the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]]. In that position, Lorteli signed warrants for the arrest of [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and presided over former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]]'s [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|case]], siding decisively with the Galactic Alliance government. Later, the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] tricked Lorteli into signing a document that gave the Jedi permission to access a [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|secret]] [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] in which psychotic Jedi Knights [[Valin Horn]] and [[Jysella Horn]] were being held in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. Lorteli was later relieved from duty by Daala.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Were you a Jedi prior to the recent Galactic Civil War?''"<br />"''Yes. ''Before'' I committed the acts for which they want to put me on trial.''"<br />"''I understand that. But in your capacity as a Jedi Knight, you were privy to a great many secrets that the Jedi Order might not want revealed in open court, were you not?''"<br />"''Oh, we ''all'' know where the Emperor buried his treasure, if that's what you're asking. I'll be glad to draw you a map&hellip;|Lorteli and Veila|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Natasi_Daala.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Arabelle Lorteli was picked by Natasi Daala (pictured) to ocersee the Court of Jedi Affairs.]]
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zoolli]] [[Judge/Legends|judge]] Arabelle Lorteli served the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> Lorteli was selected by Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to oversee the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]], which Daala formed mainly to deal with the increasingly alarming issue of young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] falling prey to a [[Force psychosis|strange illness]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors. Lorteli approved a warrant for the arrest of psychotic [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], but [[Galactic Alliance Security]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] was unable to procure the two Jedi.<ref name="Abyss" />

Later, much to the displeasure of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Lorteli oversaw the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|arraignment]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tahiri Veila]], who had, in years past, been a Jedi as well as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Lorteli sided decisively with the Galactic Alliance government and even refused to allow the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nawara Ven]] to serve as Veila's defense attorney for the case, justifying it by suggesting Veila's refusal to answer Lorteli's questions about what Jedi secrets she knew provided the possibility that Veila was close enough to the Jedi for Ven, who represented Jedi frequently, to not act with impartiality.<ref name="Abyss" />

Later, however, the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] tricked Lorteli into getting her to sign a document that granted the Jedi permission to visit<ref name="Abyss" /> [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|Detention Center 81]],<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> a [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] in which Jedi Knights [[Valin Horn]] and [[Jysella Horn]] were being held captive in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. The Horns had been captured by Galactic Alliance Security forces after falling prey to the strange psychosis, and they were eventually placed in the facility under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wruq Retk]]. A group of Jedi, accompanied by several members of the press, accessed the facility and showed the treatment the Horns were receiving, garnering public sympathy for the Jedi's situation.<ref name="Abyss" /> As a result, Daala publicly dismissed Lorteli from duty, and Judge [[Mavari Zudan]] took over Veila's case.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Since any such information you care to provide might very well have an impact on the disposition of your own case, I cannot allow Nawara Ven&mdash;or any other counsel with such a clear con ict of interests&mdash;to participate in your defense.|Lorteli, to Veila|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Lorteli thought rather highly of herself and outwardly appeared to enjoy her position as overseer of the Jedi court. Being handpicked for her position by Chief of State Daala herself, Lorteli had the freedom to act without having to worry about being particularly fair, and the judge ruled her cases decisively in favor of the ruling government.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Dialogue|Jaina Solo|As you can see, we have permission from the proper judicial authorities.|Natasi Daala|So I have been told. But we have all heard about Jedi mind tricks. This is yet more proof of their disregard for the law.|Sebatyne|If you have heard of our mind trickz, then perhaps you have also heard that they work only on the weak-minded?|Daala|I doubt this will come as a surprise to the Jedi, Master Sebatyne, but there ''are'' a few weak-minded judges serving the Galactic Alliance.|Saba Sebatyne|There ''are''? This one ''is'' outraged!|attr=Jaina Solo, Natasi Daala, and Saba Sebatyne, referring to Arabelle Lorteli|src=<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Lorteli was weak-minded and susceptible to Jedi mind tricks, as exhibited when the Jedi got her to sign a document granting them permission to enter a secret Galactic Alliance Security facility.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
Lorteli utilized a [[Datascreen/Legends|datascreen]] at her judge's bench.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arabelle Lorteli first appeared third novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', published in [[2009]] and written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Abyss" />
